cost_review: Fixed and ordinary training costs retain every objective and gradient call, all three ordinary candidates, and their wall times.
Ordinary inference batches/contexts are separate from analytic J evaluations.
Value-planner grid/refinement calls, execution rollouts/time and calibration J calls are counted separately.
The task reward b-cost does not price solver/training computation; no energy or equal-compute superiority claim follows.

executed_validation.fixtures: Artificial records and mocked evaluation only; no registered confirmation contexts generated

lifecycle_review: Training generates only train and development splits; three registered ordinary initializations are retained and development selects only among them.
The selected checkpoint must contain exactly the registered ordered fitted seeds.
Source identity binds the old imported kernels, full protocol, runtime versions and independent test reference.
A threshold-specific study registry is created exclusively before generating confirmation; copied freezes and failed attempts cannot reopen it in this trusted workspace.
Source identity is checked again after evaluation before writing the final confirmation report.
Gzip raw rollouts retain all 64 paired repeats, hit counts, terminal counts and event times; all grid/refinement searches are also retained.
limits: This is a numerical planner within the constant-threshold-per-episode family, not a global QVI optimum.
Intervals are empirical and conditional on the three frozen fits.
The b-dependent task reward is an explicit synthetic objective, additional to the unit-spike event.
Scientific advantage is not assessed until the one-shot confirmation; this review does not predict or override its gate.

mathematical_review.bootstrap: Both contrasts jointly resample complete context clusters within each fixed fit/stratum cell. No repeat is treated as an independent context.
mathematical_review.gate: Both pooled lower bounds >0.005 and every fit-seed pooled mean >0 for both contrasts; all six stratum bounds additionally >0.005 for a cross-stratum claim.
mathematical_review.multiplicity: Eight two-sided intervals, family alpha 0.05, each tail 0.003125, 4000 replicates; two pooled plus six stratum effects.
mathematical_review.primary_measure: The runner passes actual sampled per-context mean utility to summarize; analytic J is retained only for calibration.
mathematical_review.renewal_value: FPT at distance n*b plus deterministic (n-1)*refractory holding. Independent global cancellation and separate discount combine as q=lambda+rho in J, while executed rewards discount only by rho.
mathematical_review.weights: Equal strata within each fitted seed, then equal fitted seeds, both in point estimates and bootstrap.

preconfirmation_repair_retention.scope: Lifecycle validation and counter clarity only; registered distributions, scientific thresholds and fitted numerics unchanged.

implementation_configuration.ordinary_features: standardized full quadratic of all eight public inputs
implementation_configuration.selection: highest development analytic expected task utility
